items.actClause:
AN ACT to amend the general municipal law, in relation to permitting the West
Seneca central school district to establish an insurance reserve fund
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER: S6860

SPONSOR: GALLIVAN
 
TITLE OF BILL:

An act to amend the general municipal law, in relation to permitting the
West Seneca central school district to establish an insurance reserve
fund

 
PURPOSE:

To authorize the West Seneca central school district to establish an
insurance reserve fund in order to make expenditures related to claims,
et al, specific to accident and health insurance.

 
SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS:

Section one amends the general municipal law governing insurance reserve
funds to permit the West Seneca central school district to establish
such reserve funds.

Section 2 establishes the effective date.

 
JUSTIFICATION:

In an effort to contain costs associated with increasing health insur-
ance premiums, which create a significant strain on school budgets annu-
ally, many school districts have opted to move to a self-insurance model
for health benefit programs as opposed to traditional premium based
programs.

The West Seneca central school district (CSD) moved to a self-insurance
model in 2015. Doing so has been fruitful, as the district has achieved
savings since moving to said model. However, the challenge with such a
model is the lack of predictability with claims.  Such unpredictability,
coupled with the existing statutory restrictions related to fund
balances necessitates this authorization to permit the West Seneca CSD
to establish an insurance reserve fund. This fund will help offset costs
associated with payment of health care claims without placing a strain
on a particular budgetary year.

 
LEGISLATIVE HISTORY:

New bill.

 
FISCAL IMPLICATIONS:

None.

 
EFFECTIVE DATE:
This act shall take effect immediately.

summary: Permits the West Seneca central school district to establish an insurance reserve fund.
